关键词: floating rate Cumulative Class A Preference Shares, Series 25
主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced a quarterly dividend for its floating rate Cumulative Class A Preference Shares, Series 25. The dividend rate for the period October 1, 2016 to December 31, 2016 is 0.70878% (2.812% annualized), with a dividend of C$0.177195 per share payable on December 30, 2016. The company is a global alternative asset manager with approximately US$250 billion in assets under management, co-listed on the New York, Toronto and Euronext stock exchanges under the symbols BAM, BAM.A and BAMA, respectively.
